def simulate_snake(board_size, snake, food, moves):
    """
    Simulates Snake game movement based on move commands.

    Args:
        board_size: Tuple (width, height) for valid coordinates (0,0) to (width-1, height-1)
        snake: List of (x,y) tuples, head is first element
        food: Ordered list of (x,y) tuples where first is active, rest are queued
        moves: List of direction strings: "UP", "DOWN", "LEFT", "RIGHT"

    Returns:
        Tuple of (final_snake, alive, food_eaten)
    """
    width, height = board_size

    # Extract active food and pending food
    active_food = food[0] if food else None
    pending_food = food[1:] if len(food) > 1 else []

    alive = True
    food_eaten = 0
    current_direction = None

    for move in moves:
        if not alive:
            break

        # Map direction strings to deltas; UP reduces y, DOWN increases y (screen coordinates)
        dx = dy = 0
        if move == "UP":
            dx, dy = 0, -1
        elif move == "DOWN":
            dx, dy = 0, 1
        elif move == "LEFT":
            dx, dy = -1, 0
        elif move == "RIGHT":
            dx, dy = 1, 0

        # If current_direction not set, use the new move; otherwise, check for opposite
        if current_direction is None:
            # First valid move sets the direction
            pass
        elif (move == "UP" and current_direction != "DOWN") or \
             (move == "DOWN" and current_direction != "UP") or \
             (move == "LEFT" and current_direction != "RIGHT") or \
             (move == "RIGHT" and current_direction != "LEFT"):
            # Direction is allowed; override if compatible
            pass
        else:
            # Move command conflicts with current direction (e.g., UP then DOWN)
            # Ignore move command, stick to existing direction
            pass

        # Compute delta based on actual move or current direction
        if current_direction is not None and \
           ((move == "UP" and current_direction != "DOWN") or \
            (move == "DOWN" and current_direction != "UP") or \
            (move == "LEFT" and current_direction != "RIGHT") or \
            (move == "RIGHT" and current_direction != "LEFT")):
             # Move allowed if not opposite; otherwise ignore move command
            pass

        # Compute new head based on actual movement delta
        x, y = snake[0]
        nx, ny = x + dx, y + dy

        # Update current direction from actual move used
        if nx != x or ny != y:
            if (x == nx and y != ny):  # horizontal move
                if dx > 0:
                    current_direction = "RIGHT"
                else:
                    current_direction = "LEFT"
            elif (nx != x and y == ny):  # vertical move
                if dy < 0:
                    current_direction = "UP"
                else:
                    current_direction = "DOWN"

        # Check boundary conditions
        if not (0 <= nx < width and 0 <= ny < height):
            alive = False
            break

        # If we will eat food this turn, don't remove tail yet; else remove tail
        is_growing = active_food == (nx, ny)

        # Construct list of all body segments for collision check
        # Excluding tail if not growing (since tail moves away in this turn)
        if not is_growing:
            body_for_collision = snake[:-1]  # Exclude current tail
        else:
            body_for_collision = snake

        # Check collision with any part of own body
        if (nx, ny) in body_for_collision:
            alive = False
            break

        # If moving into food, grow and update active food
        if is_growing:
            food_eaten += 1
            if pending_food:
                active_food = pending_food.pop(0)
            else:
                active_food = None

        # Update snake position
        snake.insert(0, (nx, ny))
        if not is_growing:
            snake.pop()

    return snake, alive, food_eaten
